name: Bebop jazz noir
summary: Lanky, sleek, reduced-line figures with strong light-dark silhouettes in smoky, muted noir port cities with neon accents.

traits.line: reduced, simple lines (Kawamoto cut line count after Gundam 0083); sleek angular silhouettes, long legs, lanky bodies
traits.shading: hard two-tone cel shadows with clear light-dark separation designed for readable silhouettes
traits.palette: muted earthy browns, smoky blues and greys, faded yellows; dark clothing; sparing neon pink and green accents
traits.lighting: noir: blinds, smoke haze, bar light, backlit doorways, cigarette glow
traits.faces: angular, narrow eyes, distinct hairstyles and silhouettes; 'hardboiled' and adult
traits.backgrounds: gritty port cities modelled on New York and Hong Kong, desert western towns, cramped ship interiors
traits.texture: cel grain, slightly soft film look
traits.camera: shot like an independent film; western and Hong Kong action staging

style_words: Late-1990s TV cel animation, as in Cowboy Bebop (1998): reduced simple lines and sleek angular silhouettes, hard two-tone cel shading with strong light-dark separation, muted earthy browns, smoky blues and faded yellows with sparing neon accents, noir light through blinds and smoke haze, gritty painted port-city backgrounds, soft cel grain.
avoid: detailed over-rendered faces with many lines

krea2.style: Late-1990s TV cel animation, as in Cowboy Bebop: reduced simple lines, sleek angular lanky adult silhouettes, faces drawn with few lines, hard two-tone cel shading with strong light-dark separation, muted earthy browns, smoky blues and faded yellows with sparing neon accents, noir light through blinds and smoke, cel grain.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as late-1990s TV cel animation with hard two-tone cel shading and soft cel grain.

flux3_klein.style: Late-1990s TV anime cel animation in the register of Cowboy Bebop: reduced, simple dark lines with few interior strokes, sleek angular silhouettes and lanky long-legged adult bodies, angular faces with narrow eyes drawn in few lines, hard two-tone cel shadows with a strong light-dark separation, flat matte colour fills, a thin smoke haze in the air, gritty painted backgrounds, soft cel grain and a soft film look.
flux3_klein.recap: Muted earthy brown and smoky blue-grey fill the walls, the ground and the shadow fills, faded yellow stays in the lit areas and the sky, sparing neon pink and green appear only as thin rim light on edges, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a late-1990s TV cel animation frame in a signature Cowboy Bebop style, with reduced simple lines and sleek angular silhouettes, hard two-tone cel shading in flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes with strong light-dark separation, painted backgrounds and soft cel grain, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of muted earthy browns, smoky blues and greys and faded yellows, with sparing neon pink and green accents.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition separates readable silhouettes from their surroundings in hard noir light and smoky haze, with a cool, hardboiled mood, keeps to a palette of muted earthy browns, smoky blues and greys and faded yellows, with sparing neon pink and green accents, and reads throughout as a late-1990s TV cel animation frame in a signature Cowboy Bebop style, with reduced simple lines and sleek angular silhouettes, hard two-tone cel shading in flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes with strong light-dark separation, painted backgrounds and soft cel grain.
